sources_used: Facebook GOAT Games Yarmouth owner announcement (pinball/shooters/racers/classics)
Web search Canada Cineplex ITG/DDR presence; regional FEC listings

findings.name: Cineplex Cinemas Charlottetown
findings.evidence_quote: This place has no dance machine or similar types of games. ... very basic Cinescape arcade with Super Bikes, Extreme Hoops, air hockey and crane games.
findings.note: ZIv editor LABcrab explicitly states no dance/rhythm machines after 2023 reopening. Redemption/racing only.

findings.name: Cineplex Cinemas New Glasgow
findings.evidence_quote: Sometime between 10-15 years ago, this location had an ITG2. Arcade machines were not present here for several years until a couple days before typing this. Machines are distributed by Player 1 Amusement Group (P1AG).
findings.note: Historic ITG2 long gone. 2022 reinstall lineup is Super Bikes 2, Terminator Salvation, claw, stacker, basketball, hockey. No music games listed. Not rechecked since 2022.

findings.name: Cineplex Lower Sackville
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed: War Final Assault; Batman; NASCAR Racing; Big Buck Hunter Pro; Time Crisis 4; Claw Machine; Red Zone; After Burner Climax; Hockey Table.
findings.note: 2019 ZIv list is all non-rhythm. Too old and no explicit no-music statement; treat as unknown.

findings.name: Cineplex New Minas
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Crazy Taxi; Harley Davidson & LA Riders; The House of the Dead.
findings.note: Small 2019 action/racing list only. No independent confirmation of current lineup.

findings.name: Cineplex Odeon International Village
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Batman; H2Overdrive; San Francisco Rush 2049; Time Crisis 4.
findings.note: ZIv lists only racing/shooters. No explicit no-music statement. Vancouver Cineplex lobby; Japanese rhythm rare in Canada outside dedicated rooms.

findings.name: Cineplex VIP Cinemas Don Mills
findings.evidence_quote: There is no arcade per se, but billiards/pool is available to guests.
findings.note: Age-restricted VIP cinema. Only pool table listed. Not an arcade.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Cinemas Park Lane)
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Claw Machine; Key Master; Stacker; Basketball Machine; Hockey Table.
findings.note: 2024 redemption-only ZIv list. No explicit no-music statement; inventory may be incomplete.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Cinemas Summerside)
findings.evidence_quote: DDR Extreme used to be present at this location until 2023 or 2024. Cinema staff did not know current whereabouts of the machine when asked. ... It's too bad that PEI doesn't have a good dance machine.
findings.note: Former DDR Extreme removed ~2023-2024 per ZIv/staff. Remaining: Time Crisis 4, claw, stacker, basketball, hockey. No current music games.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Cinemas Yonge-Dundas and VIP)
findings.evidence_quote: There was formerly a Dance Dance Revolution Extreme machine at this arcade. It was removed many years ago.
findings.note: 2025 ZIv update: DDR Extreme long removed. Current list is Blazing Angels, Terminator Salvation, prize/redemption, Boxer, Extreme Hoops. No music games.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Odeon Barrhaven Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: There was a Dance Dance Revolution SuperNOVA machine from 2007 to 2017. As of August 2024, there is a standard Frightfearland machine, two Dead Heat machines with limited features (with player 2 out of order), two Extreme Hoops, Dynamo Hot Flash air hockey, and three prize machines.
findings.note: DDR SuperNOVA gone since 2017. Aug 2024 visitor inventory is shooters/redemption/air hockey only. No music games.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Odeon Quartier Latin)
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America) Location: It's on the second floor, at the rightmost part of the arcade. Comment: r23 + Double Premium. ... Both pads OK. This location used to have DDR Extreme, but the game has since been removed.
findings.note: ITG2 mapped to slug other (no dedicated ITG slug). DDR Extreme removed. Pad/condition notes and photo on ZIv; last editor update 2024-09. Not independently re-verified in 2025-26.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Odeon South Keys Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: The In The Groove 2 machine was removed by 2022. It is now in Kingston. No music games are currently available at this arcade.
findings.note: Explicit ZIv statement updated May 2026. Remaining cabs: Cruis'n Blast, Big Buck Hunter, Terminator, prize/redemption, Extreme Hoops.

findings.name: Cinescape (Cineplex Odeon Westhills Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Sega Golden Gun; Star Wars: Battle Pod Flat Screen Edition; The House of the Dead; Extreme Hoops; Hot Flash.
findings.note: Recent ZIv list has no music games but no explicit no-music statement. Calgary Cinescape redemption/shooter set.

findings.name: Cinescape (Galaxy Cinemas Brantford)
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Batman; Stacker; Basketball Machine. The games are reportedly out of shape.
findings.note: Tiny Cinescape. No music listed; inventory may be incomplete.

findings.name: Cinescape (Galaxy Cinemas Cornwall)
findings.evidence_quote: This Cinescape arcade formerly had an In The Groove 2 machine with multiple modern DDR packs: X2, 2014 and more. Games: Hot Flash.
findings.note: ITG2 removed; 2025 ZIv shows only air hockey Hot Flash remaining. Treat as no current rhythm games.

findings.name: Cinescape (Galaxy Cinemas Moose Jaw)
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America) Comment: It exists per Google maps as of June 2018
findings.note: Only evidence is a 2018 Google Maps mention. Page last touched 2024-08 but comment still cites 2018. Treat presence as unverified; slug other for ITG2. Needs on-site check.

findings.name: Ciné Starz Deluxe (Des Sources) (coming soon)
findings.evidence_quote: This Guzzo location has closed on December 8, 2024. Ciné Starz will reopen it as a Deluxe location this year. ... No games at this location.
findings.note: CineClock/CinéStarz site shows Des Sources open with showtimes by 2026. Former Guzzo arcade status unknown under Ciné Starz; ZIv still empty. No rhythm evidence either way.

findings.name: Ciné Starz Deluxe (Taschereau)
findings.evidence_quote: It was formerly owned by Guzzo, with games like Guitar Hero Arcade in its arcade. ... Games: Super Bikes; Mission Impossible: Arcade; The Walking Dead.
findings.note: Opened May 2025 as Ciné Starz. Former Guitar Hero under Guzzo; current ZIv list is non-rhythm only. Incomplete inventory; do not invent GH presence.

findings.name: Ciné Starz St. Laurent Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Since July 2011, this location has unfortunately removed its DDR Extreme cabinet... No music games are currently available at this arcade.
findings.note: DDR Extreme removed ~2011 (Rainbow era). 2024 ZIv: pinball/racing/boxer/air hockey, many OOO. Explicit no music games.

findings.name: Cinéma Triomphe
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Dead Heat (2P); Super Bikes 2; Time Crisis 4; Claw Machine; Stacker.
findings.note: Quebec cinema lobby cabs, non-rhythm only on ZIv. No explicit no-music statement.

findings.name: Cowboys Legends Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: In Cowboys Dance Hall at Cowboys Casino Must be 18+ ... Games: Injustice Arcade; Axe Master; Hungry Hungry Hippos; Photo Studio Deluxe; Fast & Furious Arcade (2022); Aliens Armageddon; Big Buck Hunter: Reloaded; Elevator Action Invasion; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Spider Box.
findings.note: Adult nightclub arcade. Full 2024 ZIv cab list is fighters/shooters/racing/novelty. No music/rhythm titles.

findings.name: Cravings Late Night Food
findings.evidence_quote: they have literally one cab this is a meme entry lmao ... Games: Donkey Kong
findings.note: Remote SK late-night food spot with a single DK cab per ZIv. No rhythm. Data from 2022; still classed as one-cab joke entry.

findings.name: Crowne Plaza
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Police Trainer; Buck Rogers; Cyclone; Cruis'n USA.
findings.note: Hotel lobby cabs from 2019 only. No recent confirmation of venue status or games.

findings.name: Dartmouth Bowlarama
findings.evidence_quote: Long redemption/racing list (NASCAR, Super Bikes, Big Buck Safari, claws, Deal or No Deal, Stacker, etc.). No music games in 2019 inventory.
findings.note: Bowling alley Arcade Alley still marketed (Bowlarama.ca/Facebook 40+ games, retro Pac-Man etc.). No rhythm found; list stale so unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Encore Brewing Company
findings.evidence_quote: Small brewery, 5-pin bowling center & arcade. ... Games: Ms. Pac-Man; The Fast and the Furious: Drift (2P); Basketball Machine (x2).
findings.note: Fresh July 2026 visitor inventory: retro + racing + basketball only. No music games recorded.

findings.name: Energyplex Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Super Bikes 3; Jurassic Park Arcade; Bean Bag Toss; Big Bass Wheel; Ice Ball FX; Jurassic World; Lane Master; Treasure Quest; NERF: Arcade.
findings.note: Kelowna FEC. ZIv/site describe family arcade (no rhythm named). No explicit no-music statement; incomplete for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Extreme Air Park
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location. (Comment: They should add DDR Extreme Clarity here!)
findings.note: Trampoline park (Langley). ZIv empty; pinballmap notes some pinball historically. No evidence of rhythm cabs. Not positive confirmed_none.

findings.name: Fantasy Fair
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Jetpack Joyride Arcade; Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga: 25th Anniversary; Crazy Ride; Key Master; Monopoly Roll & Go; Tippin' Bloks; Treasure Quest; XD Theater; Extreme Shot.
findings.note: Woodbine indoor amusement park arcade from video survey. Redemption/classics only on ZIv. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Flippins Bar/Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Official list: many Stern/Williams pinballs; floor games (ICE-BALL, air hockey, foosball); fighters (MK2, SSF2T, Tekken 3, Primal Rage, TMNT); shooters (Police Trainer, Big Buck Hunter, Time Crisis 3, T2); classics (Mario Bros, Pac-Man, Galaga, etc.); sports/racing (NFS Underground, Toobin', Golden Tee). No DDR/ITG/PIU or other music rhythm cabinets.
findings.note: Fredericton pinball bar opened 2024. Full published game list is positive evidence of no rhythm games. ZIv partial list aligns.

findings.name: Fun & Games
findings.evidence_quote: Long 2020 inventory of redemption/racing/hunting (Harley, SF Rush THE ROCK, Big Buck Safari, Ice Ball, Sonic, etc.). No music games listed.
findings.note: Kamloops FEC. r/Kamloops visitors seeking DDR found none citywide in a 2024 thread; Fun Factor rentals have DDR for events only. Stale ZIv; unknown.

findings.name: Funtropolis
findings.evidence_quote: Children's Entertainment Center ... small selection of Arcade Machines. Games: Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga; DK multi; Cruis'n Exotica; NASCAR; Aliens Extermination; Shrek/Spiderman/Wheel of Fortune uncertain.
findings.note: Kids FEC Laval. Retro/racing only on ZIv. Adult entry restricted with children. No rhythm found.

findings.name: GOAT Games Yarmouth
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv: Unsure of exact selection... Includes games that were formerly at Silverball Games locations... No games at this location. Owner Facebook: pinball tables, shooters, racers, and classic titles like Tetris, Pac Man, Mortal Kombat, Defender, and more.
findings.note: Owner-stated lineup is retro/pinball/shooters/racers. No rhythm games claimed. ZIv empty for specifics. conf likely not certain.

findings.name: Galaxy 51 Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Mostly redemption style games. The PIU Fiesta and Guitar Hero Arcade that used to be here seem to have been moved to Pony Boat Social Club in Charlottetown, PEI.
findings.note: Former pump_it_up (Fiesta) and Guitar Hero moved out. Remaining ZIv list is pure redemption. Note address on ZIv is 103 Union; other sources say Bedford Place Mall (may have moved within Bedford).

findings.name: Game Changerz VR
findings.evidence_quote: VRcade, no traditional machines
findings.note: Prince George VR-only venue. No traditional cabinets including no rhythm. Verify still operating under same concept if needed.

findings.name: Game Quest
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Operation Wolf; Terminator 2; Time Crisis II.
findings.note: Prince George game store (buy/sell/TCG) still open 2026. ZIv 2021 shooter cabs only; may no longer have public arcade. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Gamerama
findings.evidence_quote: Game store and ice cream parlour. Games: The King of Fighters 2002; Ms. Pac-Man; Tetris: The Grand Master 2 - The Absolute; Galaxian.
findings.note: Yonge-Eglinton retail/repair still open (gamerama.ca). 2016 cab notes are stale. TGM2 is not a music rhythm game. No music rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Gateway Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Once had ITG, then Pump It Up NX machine. RIP to both. ... Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Comment: surprisingly decent condition, works just fine. $1.00 / 1 song.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade maps to slug other (not in dedicated list). pump_it_up and ITG removed. gatewaybowl.com confirms arcade still operates at Gateway Lanes Edmonton.

findings.name: GlowZone 360
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Hot Wheels King Of The Road; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX (x2); Sno Cross; Jurassic Park Arcade; Big Bass Wheel; Down The Clown; Lane Master; Pirates Hook; Sink It; Spin N Win; Whack N Win; NERF Arcade.
findings.note: Brampton FEC redemption/racing. No rhythm on detailed ZIv list. No explicit no-music statement.

findings.name: Glowtown
findings.evidence_quote: Indoor mini-golf with a small arcade in the front. ... Games include Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Super Bikes 3, Hot Wheels, Jurassic Park, Lane Master, Piano Keys, Whack N Win, Extreme Shot, etc.
findings.note: Stouffville mini-golf arcade. Piano Keys is a ticket novelty, not a map rhythm slug. No DDR/ITG/maimai-class cabs listed.
